description: The review queue for agentic pipelines: aggregates the pending human-review records written by agentic_pipeline's `approve` op (local or s3:// gs:// abfs:// approval dirs) into a DataFrame asset, with an asset check that flags overdue reviews and an optional refresh schedule. Read-only.

outputs.description: One row per pending review: approval_dir, key, step, summary, requested_at, expires_at, age_minutes, overdue, on_timeout, approve_path.

approval_dirs.label: Approval Dirs
approval_dirs.description: Approval directories to scan -- the same `approval_dir:` values your `approve` steps use. Local paths or fsspec URIs (s3://, gs://, abfs://). Pending records live in `<dir>/pending/*.json`.

overdue_after_minutes.label: Overdue After Minutes
overdue_after_minutes.description: A pending review older than this is overdue (it is also overdue once its own `expires_at` has passed).

overdue_severity.label: Overdue Severity
overdue_severity.description: Asset check severity when reviews are overdue: 'WARN' or 'ERROR'.

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression; when set, a schedule re-materializes this asset so the queue stays current (e.g. '*/5 * * * *').

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

name: agent_review_queue
